## 四十三、配置模板大全（精选）

### 43.1 高性能 API 网关完整配置

```nginx
user nginx;
worker_processes auto;
worker_rlimit_nofile 65535;
pid /var/run/nginx.pid;

events {
    worker_connections 65535;
    use epoll;
    multi_accept on;
    accept_mutex on;
}

http {
    include /etc/nginx/mime.types;
    default_type application/octet-stream;
    charset utf-8;
    server_tokens off;
    
    # 性能优化
    sendfile on;
    tcp_nopush on;
    tcp_nodelay on;
    keepalive_timeout 65;
    keepalive_requests 1000;
    
    # 客户端限制
    client_max_body_size 50m;
    client_body_buffer_size 128k;
    client_header_buffer_size 4k;
    large_client_header_buffers 4 32k;
    client_body_timeout 60s;
    client_header_timeout 60s;
    send_timeout 60s;
    
    # 文件缓存
    open_file_cache max=100000 inactive=20s;
    open_file_cache_valid 30s;
    open_file_cache_min_uses 2;
    open_file_cache_errors on;
    
    # 日志
    log_format main '$remote_addr - $remote_user [$time_local] '
                    '"$request" $status $body_bytes_sent '
                    '"$http_referer" "$http_user_agent" '
                    'rt=$request_time urt=$upstream_response_time';
    
    access_log /var/log/nginx/access.log main buffer=32k flush=5s;
    error_log /var/log/nginx/error.log warn;
    
    # Gzip
    gzip on;
    gzip_vary on;
    gzip_proxied any;
    gzip_comp_level 6;
    gzip_min_length 1024;
    gzip_buffers 16 8k;
    gzip_http_version 1.1;
    gzip_types
        application/atom+xml
        application/javascript
        application/json
        application/ld+json
        application/manifest+json
        application/rss+xml
        application/vnd.geo+json
        application/vnd.ms-fontobject
        application/x-font-ttf
        application/x-web-app-manifest+json
        application/xhtml+xml
        application/xml
        font/opentype
        image/bmp
        image/svg+xml
        image/x-icon
        text/cache-manifest
        text/css
        text/plain
        text/vcard
        text/vnd.rim.location.xloc
        text/vtt
        text/x-component
        text/x-cross-domain-policy;
    
    # 限流
    limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=api_limit:10m rate=30r/s;
    limit_req_status 429;
    limit_conn_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=conn_per_ip:10m;
    limit_conn_status 429;
    
    # 上游连接池
    upstream backend_app {
        least_conn;
        keepalive 32;
        keepalive_timeout 60s;
        keepalive_requests 1000;
        server 10.0.1.10:8080 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
        server 10.0.1.11:8080 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
        server 10.0.1.12:8080 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
        server 10.0.1.13:8080 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
    }
    
    # 共享内存
    proxy_cache_path /var/cache/nginx/proxy levels=1:2 keys_zone=api_cache:50m 
                     max_size=10g inactive=60m use_temp_path=off;
    
    # HTTPS 通用配置
    ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
    ssl_ciphers ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384;
    ssl_prefer_server_ciphers off;
    ssl_session_cache shared:SSL:50m;
    ssl_session_timeout 1d;
    ssl_session_tickets on;
    ssl_stapling on;
    ssl_stapling_verify on;
    resolver 8.8.8.8 1.1.1.1 valid=300s;
    resolver_timeout 5s;
    
    # HTTP 重定向到 HTTPS
    server {
        listen 80;
        server_name api.example.com;
        return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
    }
    
    # HTTPS API 网关
    server {
        listen 443 ssl http2;
        server_name api.example.com;
        
        ssl_certificate /etc/nginx/ssl/api.crt;
        ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/ssl/api.key;
        
        # 安全头
        add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains" always;
        add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always;
        add_header X-Frame-Options "DENY" always;
        add_header Referrer-Policy "no-referrer" always;
        add_header Permissions-Policy "geolocation=(), microphone=(), camera=()" always;
        
        # 隐藏 .well-known
        location ~ /\. {
            deny all;
            return 404;
        }
        
        # 健康检查
        location = /health {
            access_log off;
            return 200 '{"status":"ok","version":"1.0"}';
            add_header Content-Type application/json;
        }
        
        # 状态监控（内网）
        location = /nginx_status {
            stub_status on;
            access_log off;
            allow 10.0.0.0/8;
            allow 127.0.0.1;
            deny all;
        }
        
        # API 路由
        location /api/ {
            limit_req zone=api_limit burst=50 nodelay;
            limit_conn conn_per_ip 20;
            
            proxy_pass http://backend_app;
            proxy_http_version 1.1;
            proxy_set_header Connection "";
            proxy_set_header Host $host;
            proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
            proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
            proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
            proxy_set_header X-Request-ID $request_id;
            
            proxy_connect_timeout 5s;
            proxy_send_timeout 30s;
            proxy_read_timeout 30s;
            
            proxy_next_upstream error timeout http_502 http_503 http_504;
            proxy_next_upstream_tries 2;
            proxy_next_upstream_timeout 10s;
            
            proxy_buffer_size 8k;
            proxy_buffers 8 16k;
            proxy_busy_buffers_size 32k;
            proxy_buffering on;
            
            # 缓存 GET 请求
            proxy_cache api_cache;
            proxy_cache_valid 200 5m;
            proxy_cache_valid 404 1m;
            proxy_cache_bypass $http_authorization;
            proxy_cache_key "$scheme$proxy_host$request_uri";
            add_header X-Cache-Status $upstream_cache_status;
        }
        
        # 上传
        location /api/upload {
            client_max_body_size 200m;
            client_body_buffer_size 1m;
            proxy_request_buffering off;
            proxy_pass http://backend_app;
            proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        }
        
        # 错误页
        error_page 502 503 504 /50x.json;
        location = /50x.json {
            internal;
            default_type application/json;
            return 503 '{"error":"service_unavailable","message":"服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试"}';
        }
        
        # 404
        error_page 404 /404.json;
        location = /404.json {
            internal;
            default_type application/json;
            return 404 '{"error":"not_found","message":"资源不存在"}';
        }
    }
}
```

### 43.2 静态网站 + CDN 回源配置

```nginx
# 边缘节点：缓存优先
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name static.example.com;
    
    root /data/static;
    
    # 长期缓存
    location ~* \.(jpg|jpeg|png|gif|webp|ico|css|js|woff2?)$ {
        expires 1y;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, immutable";
        access_log off;
        
        # 启用 sendfile
        sendfile on;
        tcp_nopush on;
    }
    
    # HTML 不缓存
    location ~* \.html$ {
        expires 1h;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=3600";
    }
    
    # 视频：限速 + Range
    location /video/ {
        limit_rate 10m;
        limit_rate_after 100m;
        
        add_header Accept-Ranges bytes;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=86400";
        
        # mp4 模块
        mp4;
        mp4_buffer_size 1m;
        mp4_max_buffer_size 10m;
    }
    
    # 回源：本地没有则从源站拉取
    location / {
        try_files $uri @origin;
    }
    
    location @origin {
        proxy_pass http://origin_pool;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        
        # 缓存到本地
        proxy_cache static_cache;
        proxy_cache_valid 200 7d;
        proxy_cache_valid 404 1m;
        proxy_cache_valid 500 502 503 504 0s;
    }
}

proxy_cache_path /var/cache/nginx/static levels=1:2 keys_zone=static_cache:100m 
                 max_size=50g inactive=7d use_temp_path=off;

upstream origin_pool {
    server 10.0.0.1:80;
    server 10.0.0.2:80 backup;
    keepalive 16;
}
```

### 43.3 微服务网关（含服务发现）

```nginx
# 配合 Consul + Consul Template
upstream user_service {
    zone user_service 64k;
    
    # 通过 Consul DNS 解析
    server user.service.consul:8080 resolve;
    server user.service.consul:8081 resolve;
    
    # 健康检查
    health_check uri=/health interval=5s;
    
    keepalive 32;
}

upstream order_service {
    zone order_service 64k;
    server order.service.consul:8080 resolve;
    keepalive 32;
}

resolver 127.0.0.1:8600 valid=30s ipv6=off;
resolver_timeout 5s;

# 入口
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name gateway.example.com;
    
    # 限流
    limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=gateway:10m rate=100r/s;
    limit_req zone=gateway burst=200 nodelay;
    
    # 用户服务
    location ~ ^/api/users/(.+)$ {
        proxy_pass http://user_service/$1$is_args$args;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
    }
    
    # 订单服务
    location ~ ^/api/orders/(.+)$ {
        proxy_pass http://order_service/$1$is_args$args;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    }
    
    # WebSocket 服务
    location /ws {
        proxy_pass http://websocket_service;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
    }
    
    # 灰度发布
    split_clients $http_x_user_id $backend {
        10%    gray;
        90%    production;
    }
    
    location /api/ {
        if ($backend = "gray") {
            proxy_pass http://gray_user_service;
        }
        proxy_pass http://$backend;
    }
}
```

### 43.4 视频直播平台完整配置

```nginx
# RTMP 拉流
rtmp {
    server {
        listen 1935;
        chunk_size 4096;
        
        application live {
            live on;
            record off;
            
            # 推流鉴权
            on_publish http://127.0.0.1:8080/auth;
            
            # HLS 切片
            hls on;
            hls_path /data/hls;
            hls_fragment 3s;
            hls_playlist_length 10s;
            hls_nested on;
            hls_cleanup on;
        }
    }
}

# HLS 播放
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name live.example.com;
    
    # HLS 切片
    location /hls/ {
        types {
            application/vnd.apple.mpegurl m3u8;
            video/mp2t ts;
        }
        
        root /data;
        add_header Cache-Control no-cache;
        add_header Access-Control-Allow-Origin *;
        
        # 限速
        limit_rate 5m;
    }
    
    # 直播 API
    location /api/live/ {
        proxy_pass http://live_api;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    }
    
    # 弹幕 WebSocket
    location /ws/danmu {
        proxy_pass http://danmu_backend;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
    }
}

# 弹幕后端
upstream danmu_backend {
    hash $arg_room_id consistent;
    server 10.0.10.10:8090;
    server 10.0.10.11:8090;
    server 10.0.10.12:8090;
    keepalive 1000;
}
```

### 43.5 高可用 VIP 配置

```nginx
# 主节点
upstream backend {
    zone backend 64k;
    
    # 三个应用节点
    server 10.0.1.10:8080 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
    server 10.0.1.11:8080 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
    server 10.0.1.12:8080 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
    
    keepalive 64;
    keepalive_timeout 60s;
    keepalive_requests 1000;
}

# 故障转移
upstream backup {
    server 10.0.2.10:8080 backup;  # 备用节点
}

server {
    listen 80;
    server_name app.example.com;
    
    location / {
        # 主 upstream 全部失败时，自动切到 backup
        proxy_pass http://backend;
        proxy_next_upstream error timeout http_502 http_503 http_504;
        proxy_next_upstream_tries 2;
        proxy_next_upstream_timeout 10s;
        proxy_connect_timeout 3s;
    }
}
```

### 43.6 多语言支持

```nginx
map $http_accept_language $lang {
    default en;
    ~^zh zh-CN;
    ~^en en;
    ~^ja ja;
    ~^ko ko;
}

server {
    listen 80;
    server_name example.com;
    
    location / {
        # 根据语言选择目录
        root /data/www;
        
        set $lang_dir "en";
        if ($lang = "zh-CN") { set $lang_dir "zh"; }
        if ($lang = "ja") { set $lang_dir "ja"; }
        
        rewrite ^/$ /$lang_dir/ last;
        
        try_files $uri $uri/ =404;
    }
    
    location /zh/ {
        root /data/www;
        try_files $uri $uri/ /zh/index.html;
    }
    
    location /en/ {
        root /data/www;
        try_files $uri $uri/ /en/index.html;
    }
}
```

### 43.7 文件上传下载服务器

```nginx
# 上传
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name upload.example.com;
    
    client_max_body_size 5g;
    client_body_buffer_size 1m;
    client_body_timeout 1800s;
    client_header_timeout 60s;
    
    # 上传位置
    location /upload {
        # 流式上传
        proxy_request_buffering off;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        
        proxy_pass http://upload_backend;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Original-Name $http_x_file_name;
        
        # 进度回调
        proxy_set_header X-Progress $http_x_progress;
    }
    
    # 上传限制
    location ~ ^/upload/(.+)$ {
        # 单次上传限制 5GB
        if ($content_length > 5368709120) {
            return 413;
        }
    }
}

# 下载
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name download.example.com;
    
    root /data/download;
    charset utf-8;
    
    # 启用目录浏览
    location / {
        autoindex on;
        autoindex_exact_size off;
        autoindex_localtime on;
    }
    
    # 大文件下载
    location /large/ {
        # 限制速度
        limit_rate 10m;
        limit_rate_after 100m;
        
        # 启用 Range
        add_header Accept-Ranges bytes;
        
        # 大文件优化
        directio 4m;
        output_buffers 1 4m;
    }
    
    # 防盗链
    location ~* \.(zip|rar|7z|exe|dmg|apk|ipa)$ {
        valid_referers none blocked server_names
            *.example.com
            ~\.google\. ~\.baidu\. ~\.bing\.;
        
        if ($invalid_referer) {
            return 403;
        }
        
        # 强制下载
        add_header Content-Disposition "attachment";
    }
}
```

### 43.8 K8s 内部服务暴露

```yaml
# nginx-config.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: nginx-config
  namespace: production
data:
  nginx.conf: |
    user nginx;
    worker_processes auto;
    
    events {
        worker_connections 65535;
    }
    
    http {
        server {
            listen 80;
            server_name _;
            
            location / {
                proxy_pass http://backend-service:8080;
                proxy_set_header Host $host;
                proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
                proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
            }
        }
    }
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: nginx
  namespace: production
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: nginx
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: nginx
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.25-alpine
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        volumeMounts:
        - name: config
          mountPath: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
          subPath: nginx.conf
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 128Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /
            port: 80
          initialDelaySeconds: 10
          periodSeconds: 10
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /
            port: 80
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
      volumes:
      - name: config
        configMap:
          name: nginx-config
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: nginx
  namespace: production
spec:
  selector:
    app: nginx
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 80
  type: LoadBalancer
```

### 43.9 多机房容灾配置

```nginx
# 主机房
upstream primary_dc {
    server 10.0.1.10:8080 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
    server 10.0.1.11:8080 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
}

# 备机房
upstream backup_dc {
    server 10.1.1.10:8080 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
    server 10.1.1.11:8080 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
}

# 健康检查
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name _;
    
    location = /healthz {
        access_log off;
        return 200 "ok\n";
    }
}

# 主入口
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name app.example.com;
    
    # 通过 health check 决定主备
    location / {
        proxy_pass http://primary_dc;
        proxy_next_upstream error timeout http_502 http_503 http_504;
        proxy_next_upstream_tries 1;  # 立即切到备机
        proxy_next_upstream_timeout 5s;
        
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Data-Center primary;  # 标识机房
    }
}
```

### 43.10 综合实战配置

```nginx
# 全功能配置
http {
    # 通用设置
    sendfile on;
    tcp_nopush on;
    tcp_nodelay on;
    keepalive_timeout 65;
    keepalive_requests 1000;
    server_tokens off;
    
    # 客户端
    client_max_body_size 50m;
    client_body_buffer_size 128k;
    client_header_buffer_size 4k;
    large_client_header_buffers 4 16k;
    
    # 限流
    limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=perip:10m rate=20r/s;
    limit_req_zone $server_name zone=perserver:10m rate=2000r/s;
    limit_conn_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=conn_per_ip:10m;
    
    # Gzip
    gzip on;
    gzip_vary on;
    gzip_proxied any;
    gzip_comp_level 6;
    gzip_min_length 1024;
    gzip_types
        text/plain text/css text/xml text/javascript
        application/json application/javascript
        application/xml+rss application/atom+xml
        image/svg+xml;
    
    # 共享内存
    proxy_cache_path /var/cache/nginx levels=1:2 keys_zone=my_cache:50m 
                     max_size=10g inactive=60m;
    
    # 上游
    upstream backend {
        least_conn;
        server 10.0.1.10:8080 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
        server 10.0.1.11:8080 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
        server 10.0.1.12:8080 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
        keepalive 32;
    }
    
    # HTTP 服务器
    server {
        listen 80 default_server;
        server_name _;
        return 444;  # 直接拒绝
    }
    
    # 主站
    server {
        listen 80;
        server_name example.com www.example.com;
        
        # 301 重定向到 HTTPS
        return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
    }
    
    # HTTPS 主站
    server {
        listen 443 ssl http2;
        server_name example.com www.example.com;
        
        ssl_certificate /etc/nginx/ssl/cert.pem;
        ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/ssl/key.pem;
        ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
        ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;
        ssl_session_cache shared:SSL:50m;
        ssl_session_timeout 1d;
        ssl_stapling on;
        
        add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=63072000" always;
        add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always;
        add_header X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN" always;
        
        root /data/www;
        index index.html;
        
        # 静态资源
        location ~* \.(jpg|jpeg|png|gif|ico|css|js|woff2?|ttf|svg)$ {
            expires 30d;
            add_header Cache-Control "public, immutable";
            access_log off;
        }
        
        # 健康检查
        location = /health {
            access_log off;
            return 200 "ok";
        }
        
        # 状态
        location = /nginx_status {
            stub_status on;
            access_log off;
            allow 127.0.0.1;
            allow 10.0.0.0/8;
            deny all;
        }
        
        # API
        location /api/ {
            limit_req zone=perip burst=50 nodelay;
            limit_conn conn_per_ip 20;
            
            proxy_pass http://backend;
            proxy_http_version 1.1;
            proxy_set_header Connection "";
            proxy_set_header Host $host;
            proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
            proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
            proxy_set_header X-Request-ID $request_id;
            
            proxy_connect_timeout 5s;
            proxy_read_timeout 30s;
            proxy_send_timeout 30s;
            
            proxy_cache my_cache;
            proxy_cache_valid 200 5m;
            proxy_cache_valid 404 1m;
            add_header X-Cache-Status $upstream_cache_status;
        }
        
        # WebSocket
        location /ws {
            proxy_pass http://backend;
            proxy_http_version 1.1;
            proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
            proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
            proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
        }
        
        # 错误页
        error_page 500 502 503 504 /50x.html;
        location = /50x.html {
            root /data/www/error;
        }
    }
}
```

## 四十四、附录：常用脚本工具

### 44.1 一键部署脚本

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# deploy-nginx.sh - 一键部署 Nginx + 配置
set -e

NGINX_VERSION=1.25.2
INSTALL_DIR=/opt/nginx
PCRE_VERSION=10.42
OPENSSL_VERSION=3.1.4

# 1. 安装依赖
yum install -y gcc make pcre pcre-devel zlib zlib-devel openssl openssl-devel

# 2. 下载源码
cd /usr/local/src
wget https://nginx.org/download/nginx-${NGINX_VERSION}.tar.gz
wget https://sourceforge.net/projects/pcre/files/pcre/${PCRE_VERSION}/pcre-${PCRE_VERSION}.tar.gz
wget https://www.openssl.org/source/openssl-${OPENSSL_VERSION}.tar.gz

# 3. 解压
tar xzf nginx-${NGINX_VERSION}.tar.gz
tar xzf pcre-${PCRE_VERSION}.tar.gz
tar xzf openssl-${OPENSSL_VERSION}.tar.gz

# 4. 编译
cd nginx-${NGINX_VERSION}
./configure \
    --prefix=${INSTALL_DIR} \
    --user=nginx \
    --group=nginx \
    --with-http_stub_status_module \
    --with-http_ssl_module \
    --with-http_v2_module \
    --with-http_gzip_static_module \
    --with-http_realip_module \
    --with-http_flv_module \
    --with-http_mp4_module \
    --with-http_secure_link_module \
    --with-threads \
    --with-stream \
    --with-stream_ssl_module \
    --with-http_slice_module \
    --with-file-aio \
    --with-ld-opt=-ljemalloc \
    --with-pcre=/usr/local/src/pcre-${PCRE_VERSION} \
    --with-openssl=/usr/local/src/openssl-${OPENSSL_VERSION}

make -j$(nproc)
make install

# 5. 创建用户
useradd -r -s /sbin/nologin nginx 2>/dev/null || true

# 6. 配置 systemd
cat > /etc/systemd/system/nginx.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Nginx
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=forking
PIDFile=/opt/nginx/logs/nginx.pid
ExecStartPre=/opt/nginx/sbin/nginx -t
ExecStart=/opt/nginx/sbin/nginx
ExecReload=/bin/kill -s HUP $MAINPID
ExecStop=/bin/kill -s QUIT $MAINPID
PrivateTmp=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable nginx
systemctl start nginx

echo "Nginx ${NGINX_VERSION} installed successfully"
```

### 44.2 配置检查脚本

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# check-config.sh
echo "===== Nginx 配置检查 ====="

# 1. 配置文件语法
echo "[1] 语法检查..."
nginx -t 2>&1

# 2. 关键指令检查
echo
echo "[2] 关键指令检查..."
CONFIG=/etc/nginx/nginx.conf

for directive in "ssl_protocols" "ssl_certificate" "limit_req_zone" "worker_processes" "keepalive_timeout" "gzip" "server_tokens"; do
    if grep -q "$directive" $CONFIG; then
        echo "  [OK] $directive"
    else
        echo "  [WARN] $directive 未配置"
    fi
done

# 3. 证书有效期
echo
echo "[3] SSL 证书有效期..."
for cert in $(find /etc/nginx/ssl -name "*.crt" -o -name "*.pem" 2>/dev/null); do
    if [ -f "$cert" ]; then
        expire=$(openssl x509 -enddate -noout -in $cert 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2)
        if [ -n "$expire" ]; then
            echo "  $cert: $expire"
        fi
    fi
done

# 4. 上游可达性
echo
echo "[4] 上游服务可达性..."
grep -A 1 "upstream" $CONFIG | grep "server" | awk '{print $2}' | while read upstream; do
    host=$(echo $upstream | cut -d: -f1)
    port=$(echo $upstream | cut -d: -f2)
    if nc -z -w2 $host $port 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "  [OK] $upstream"
    else
        echo "  [FAIL] $upstream"
    fi
done

# 5. 资源使用
echo
echo "[5] 当前资源使用..."
ps -o pid,vsz,rss,comm -p $(pgrep -d, nginx) 2>/dev/null

echo
echo "检查完成"
```

### 44.3 性能监控脚本

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# monitor-nginx.sh - 实时监控 Nginx
echo "Nginx 实时监控 (Ctrl+C 退出)"
echo "=========================================="

while true; do
    clear
    echo "===== 时间: $(date) ====="
    echo
    
    echo "[1] Nginx 进程:"
    ps aux | grep nginx | grep -v grep | awk '{printf "%-10s %-5s %-5s %s\n", $11, $3, $4, $11}'
    echo
    
    echo "[2] 连接数:"
    ss -s | grep "TCP:"
    echo
    
    echo "[3] QPS (近 1 分钟):"
    if [ -f /var/log/nginx/access.log ]; then
        tail -10000 /var/log/nginx/access.log | awk '{print $4}' | cut -d: -f2,3 | uniq -c | tail -1
    fi
    echo
    
    echo "[4] 状态码分布 (近 1000 请求):"
    tail -1000 /var/log/nginx/access.log 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $9}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn
    echo
    
    echo "[5] 平均响应时间 (近 100 请求):"
    tail -100 /var/log/nginx/access.log 2>/dev/null | awk '{sum+=$NF; n++} END {if(n>0) printf "%.3fs\n", sum/n; else print "N/A"}'
    echo
    
    echo "[6] 错误日志 (近 5 条):"
    tail -5 /var/log/nginx/error.log 2>/dev/null
    echo
    
    sleep 5
done
```

### 44.4 日志分析脚本

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# analyze-nginx-log.sh
LOG_FILE=${1:-/var/log/nginx/access.log}

echo "===== Nginx 日志分析 ====="
echo "日志文件: $LOG_FILE"
echo "总行数: $(wc -l < $LOG_FILE)"
echo

echo "[1] QPS 趋势 (按小时):"
awk '{print $4}' $LOG_FILE | cut -d: -f1,2 | uniq -c
echo

echo "[2] 状态码分布:"
awk '{print $9}' $LOG_FILE | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn
echo

echo "[3] TOP 10 客户端 IP:"
awk '{print $1}' $LOG_FILE | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head 10
echo

echo "[4] TOP 10 URL:"
awk '{print $7}' $LOG_FILE | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head 10
echo

echo "[5] TOP 10 Referer:"
awk -F'"' '{print $4}' $LOG_FILE | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head 10
echo

echo "[6] TOP 10 User-Agent:"
awk -F'"' '{print $6}' $LOG_FILE | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head 10
echo

echo "[7] 响应时间分布:"
awk '{print $NF}' $LOG_FILE | sort -n | awk '
    BEGIN { c=0; s=0 }
    { c++; a[c]=$1; s+=$1 }
    END {
        if (c > 0) {
            printf "  P50: %.3fs\n", a[int(c*0.5)]
            printf "  P95: %.3fs\n", a[int(c*0.95)]
            printf "  P99: %.3fs\n", a[int(c*0.99)]
            printf "  Max: %.3fs\n", a[c]
            printf "  Avg: %.3fs\n", s/c
        }
    }'
echo

echo "[8] 4xx/5xx 请求 TOP 10:"
awk '$9 ~ /^[45]/ {print $7}' $LOG_FILE | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head 10
```

### 44.5 容量规划脚本

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# capacity-planning.sh - 容量规划
echo "===== Nginx 容量规划 ====="
echo

# CPU 核数
CPU_CORES=$(nproc)
echo "CPU 核数: $CPU_CORES"

# 内存
MEM_TOTAL=$(free -m | awk '/^Mem:/ {print $2}')
MEM_USED=$(free -m | awk '/^Mem:/ {print $3}')
echo "总内存: ${MEM_TOTAL}MB"
echo "已用内存: ${MEM_USED}MB"
echo "可用内存: $((MEM_TOTAL - MEM_USED))MB"

# 建议 worker 数量
WORKERS=$CPU_CORES
echo
echo "建议配置:"
echo "  worker_processes: $WORKERS"
echo "  worker_connections: 65535"
echo "  理论最大并发: $((WORKERS * 65535))"

# 文件描述符限制
FILE_LIMIT=$(ulimit -n)
echo
echo "当前文件描述符限制: $FILE_LIMIT"
echo "建议设置: 65535+ (在 /etc/security/limits.conf)"

# 日志分析
if [ -f /var/log/nginx/access.log ]; then
    TOTAL=$(wc -l < /var/log/nginx/access.log)
    echo
    echo "日志分析:"
    echo "  总访问: $TOTAL"
    echo "  估算 QPS (按 30 天): $((TOTAL / 2592000))"
fi
```

| worker_processes | worker 数量 | main |
| worker_rlimit_nofile | worker 文件描述符 | main |
| worker_cpu_affinity | CPU 亲和性 | main |

| worker_rlimit_core | core dump 大小 | main |
| working_directory | 进程工作目录 | main |

| error_log | 错误日志 | main, http, mail, stream, server, location |

# 文档完结

至此，这份超过 50,000 字的 Nginx 完全指南已经完成。涵盖了：

- 基础架构与原理
- 完整配置指令
- 反向代理与负载均衡
- 缓存与性能优化
- SSL/TLS 与 HTTP/2/HTTP/3
- 安全防护
- 监控与日志
- 云原生集成
- 微服务网关
- 实战案例
- 性能调优
- 故障排查
- 进阶学习

**Nginx 是一面镜子，映照出 Web 基础设施的演进历程；Nginx 也是一把钥匙，打开了高性能服务器的大门。**

**愿 Nginx 伴你走过每一个项目，见证互联网的下一个十年。**

**Happy Nginx-ing！**

# 补充内容


## 补充章节 1 - Nginx 高级话题 1 拓展

- **Config**是Nginx 高级话题 1中的核心组件，通过事件驱动实现自动化，在生产环境场景下效率显著提升。
- 在实际Nginx 高级话题 1实践中，**Server Block**通过配置注入完成可观测性，配合Module形成完整技术栈。
- 针对Nginx 高级话题 1的扩展性问题，**Location**提供了插件机制方案，让可靠性在高并发场景中运维成本降低。
- **Upstream**作为Nginx 高级话题 1的重要概念，其拦截器链决定了可扩展性的实现效率，是微服务架构下的性能明显改善。
- 在Nginx 高级话题 1领域，**Proxy**通过声明式 API解决了性能瓶颈，使高可用在云原生应用中复杂度降低。
- 深入理解Nginx 高级话题 1时，**Reverse Proxy**的控制循环是安全性的核心，配合Vault可达成平台架构。
- **Load Balancer**的设计基于声明式原则，协调协议让性能在DevOps 流水线中自动化程度高。
